summary: Final acceptance does not pass. The code and the data are correct, and all three project gates pass. Three blockers remain. The latest phase acceptance audits 4f53364, and later commits change track paths that are not plan or evidence files. The plan has four phases, and only Phase 3 has a passing phase acceptance. The registry row and metadata still describe an unfinished track with open owner decisions. Nonblocking gaps: stale 34-run counts, labeled evidence with no command, and findings that never reached tech-debt.md.
blocking_findings: FA-1 [Blocker] phase-acceptance coverage: `git diff --name-only 4f53364 7aeaba8` lists docs/assets/data/benchmark.json, docs/assets/data/bugfix.json, docs/assets/data/tracks.json, measure/tracks/domain_trust/plan.md, and measure/tracks/domain_trust/spec.md. The three data files are track paths (changed by track commits a1d3be9 and 96a9197), and spec.md is not a plan or evidence file. So the later commits are not covered, and measure/runs/domain_trust/phase-acceptance-p3-4f53364.json audits 4f53364437a633f523b1f6143ac7d060dcfcb19a, not HEAD 7aeaba8328a1d9929c4a1b5c39203f8d99d640b5. Fix: run a phase acceptance at HEAD 7aeaba8, then re-run final acceptance.

FA-2 [Blocker] phase coverage: plan.md has four phases (lines 74, 110, 140, 251). measure/runs/domain_trust holds exactly one passing phase-acceptance result, phase-acceptance-p3-4f53364.json for Phase 3. Phase 1 (contract and setup), Phase 2 (Red), and Phase 4 (owner gate and merge) have no passing phase-acceptance result. Phase 4 holds the merge and the export, which are the highest-risk changes in the track.

FA-3 [Blocker] A6 registry and metadata truth: measure/tracks.md:27 still reads "pending — strategy done; Phase 1 worktree next; owner decisions O1 and O2 open". plan.md holds 15 [x] tasks, 0 open tasks, and 0 blocked tasks, and spec.md:343-344 records O1 approved 2026-10-25 and O2 approved 2026-11-25. measure/tracks/domain_trust/metadata.json still holds "status": "pending" and "actual_tasks": null. The anti-pattern A6 check fails, and this role does not edit the registry or metadata.
nonblocking_findings: NB-1 plan and spec truthfulness (PA-P3-2, PA-P3-4): plan.md:82 says `jq '[.models[].runs | length] | add' measure/tracks/domain_trust/preview.json` prints 34. It prints 58 after commit 7c5a825. spec.md EV5 says the export selects 34 runs, and test-strategy.md:302 says 34 runs with 49 safe, 14 unoptimized, 32 risk, 17 unproven. The export now holds 58 runs with 51 safe, 14 unoptimized, 33 risk, 14 unproven.

NB-2 plan evidence without a command (PA-P3-2): plan.md task 3.3 records `PAGE_DESCRIBE_CHECK=pass`, `AFFECTED_CELLS=17`, and `COVERAGE_LABELS=251`, and task 3.2 records `PARTIAL_NO_BLOCK=true` and `PARTIAL_BYTE_IDENTICAL=true`, with no command or log that prints them.
NB-3 measure/runs/domain_trust/phase-acceptance-p3-4f53364.json records `track_base_sha: null`, so the phase result does not bind its own track base.
NB-4 late findings: tech-debt.md holds no entry for A-P3-1..8, ADV-P3-1..8, UX-P3-1..11, or PA-P3-1..5, although plan.md tasks 3.5, 3.6, and 3.7 say those findings go to tech-debt.

NB-5 orchestration: the supplied gate command sets only PROJECT_TESTS. PROJECT_LINT and PROJECT_CHECKS are unset, so the gate fails on them before it reads the result. I ran both gates myself and both pass.
NB-6 the repo has no measure/doctor.sh and no measure/gates.json, so this audit used the configured project gates (PM 2026-11-25).
